subject: english-literature
source_note: Topic structure follows the OCR GCSE English Literature specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

units.name: Exploring modern and literary heritage texts

connections.why: Studying a modern and a 19th-century text side by side highlights how social context shapes prose across two centuries
Both are literary-heritage texts requiring close reading informed by historical and social context
Analysing poetic form and imagery across periods sharpens the language analysis applied to Shakespeare's verse
Modern themes and voices in the set text resonate with the contemporary poems studied across time
Reading 19th-century prose deepens the contextual grasp needed for the older poems in the 'poetry across time' selection
